52310.author: makortel
52310.body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47593
and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47960

#### PR description:

Following a request in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52304 this PR backports #47593 and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47960 into 14_2_X (following the policy of requiring backports to be included in all the intermediate release cycles).
#### PR validation:

None

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:
52310.title: [14_2_X] XrdAdaptor: Use inactive sources first before trying to open a new source when handling a failed request, and Increase RequestTimeout to three times the StreamTimeout

52421.author: makortel
52421.body:
#### PR description:

This PR backports https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911 following the request in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/47050#issuecomment-6069544996 . To make the backport more straightforward the following additional cleanup PRs are included
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47914
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49134
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49430

This backport is done as a forward-port of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52369. All commits of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52369 applied cleanly to 14_2_X.

#### PR validation:

None beyond https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52369

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47914, https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49134, https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49430, and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911.
52421.title: [14_2_X] Clean up InputFileCatalog (including rfio, TrivialFileCatalog) and reduce its memory usage
